newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka's 1996 exports rise 12 percent-ADB.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka's 1996 exports rise 12 percent-ADB.

text.p: Sri Lanka's exports rose by 12 percent in 1996 despite a poor performance by the manufacturing sector, but the growth rate was down from the 18.4 percent of the previous year, the Asian Development Bank (ADB) said on Thursday.
The Manila-based bank said in its annual report that exports in 1996 were worth $4.2 billion against $3.8 billion in 1995.
The report forecast Sri Lanka's exports will grow by 17 percent to $4.97 billion this year and are seen rising to above five billion dollars in 1998.
